description: Copy a template deck through Drive, then add one slide per outline entry from the named layout, filling its title/subtitle/body placeholders and speaker notes, and delete the template's own slides unless kept. The outline is checked against the template before anything is copied.

account.description: Which account this writes as: a label from list_accounts (its editors section). Required; writes have no default.

folder_id.description: Drive folder id to create it in. Takes precedence over folder_path.

folder_path.description: Folder path under My Drive, e.g. "Clients/Acme". Both empty means the root.

body.description: Text for the body placeholder; a list is one line each.

layout.description: A layout name from list_layouts, e.g. "Title and body".

template_id.description: The template deck's id, or its URL.

name: create_deck_from_outline
title: Create a deck from an outline
